subject: [PATCH v3 00/20] iomap: convert to in-iter iomap_next() model

reviews.author: changfengnan
reviews.summary: Reviewer changfengnan confirmed that the simple direct I/O path does not experience performance degradation after converting to the in-iter iomap_next() model.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Christoph,
I tested the simple direct I/O path and did not observe any performance
degradation.

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Reviewer Christoph Hellwig expressed disappointment that the patch series still doesn't show any performance improvements, despite his previous suggestion for converting iomap to an iterator model.
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks.  But no improvement either?

I'll respin this to sit before the iter_next conversion and will
send it out.

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Christoph Hellwig expressed concerns about the simple dio part of the patch series, but provided a revised version of his own patch for that section. He also gave a Reviewed-by tag to the core iomap bits.
reviews.raw_body:
As mentioned in the coverletter not a fan of the simple dio part
of this, but I'll post a version of my patch for that that slots
in before this.  For the core iomap bits:

Reviewed-by: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary:
Author clarified her approach to cc'ing maintainers and filesystem developers in future patch series, indicating she is open to feedback on this aspect but did not address any technical concerns.

Author acknowledged that Christoph's series needs to be folded into v4, indicating a plan to address the merge logistics concern.
reviews.raw_body:
I'm not sure what the general etiquette is, so I tried to avoid
spamming people's inboxes by removing the filesystem-specific lists
and only cc'ing the maintainers since everyone is cc'ed for the whole
series and not just their individual patch. If the filesystem specific
lists should also be added though, I will make sure to do that going
forward.

---

Sounds good. I will fold your series in [1] into v4 after awaiting
replies on that series.

Thanks,
Joanne

[1] https://lore.kernel.org/linux-fsdevel/20260722124931.3159664-1-hch@lst.de/

2026-07-22.patch_summary: This patch series converts the iomap code to use an iterator model, replacing the current begin/end pair of callbacks with a single next callback. This change allows for better performance by enabling inlining and devirtualization of the iteration loop, as well as providing more flexibility for future callers to express custom logic in the IO path. The patches are broken down into 20 parts, including refactoring existing code, converting each filesystem, removing legacy paths, and updating documentation.
